The **Pump Action Shotgun** is a weapon in *Fallout 76*.

A *76 Magnum* model by weapons manufacturer Romington. [1] 

A shotgun that fires shells using a pump-action mechanism. Its default configuration features rifle sights and a wooden forearm and birdshead-style pistol grip. Longer barrel modifications also add an aesthetic heat shield to the barrel. The pump action shotgun has a fixed magazine capacity of 8, even though the length of the magazine tube changes depending on the barrel type. Combined with damage increasing shotgun perks and the Enforcer perk allows for the crippling of target limbs with each projectile (8 pellets = 8 chances to cripple).
